invariants: Every neutral flag present at battle start must receive its own dedicated capture squad/order before the main BTG opening is released.
A missing special pointstart unit must never cancel map coverage: ordinary infantry is the fallback capture squad.
The opening patrol helicopter must never block the serialized ground spawn queue, even if the engine accepts it without a GameSpawn callback.
Do not form/release the main BTG until opening coverage has been assigned to every start-neutral flag or that flag is already owned by the bot team.

phase_1_all_neutral_flags_first.for_each_start_neutral_flag: create one dedicated capture request bound to that exact flag
phase_1_all_neutral_flags_first.retry_until: capture squad receives its target/order or flag is already owned
phase_1_all_neutral_flags_first.main_opening_gate: FROZEN until every start-neutral flag is covered
phase_1_all_neutral_flags_first.example: 11 neutral flags => 11 separate capture squads/orders before BTG release

opening_patrol_helicopter.missing_GameSpawn_callback: must not block any ground unit spawn

states.OPENING: execute all-neutral coverage gate, then main combat opening
states.EXPAND: attack uncaptured flags; keep per-squad target until captured/disappears
states.DEFEND: when own flags >= enemy flags + 1, living combat squads defend owned flags
states.WAIT_REINFORCEMENT: pause normal expansion after loss of recon/tank/mech_inf/attack_heli until replacement arrives

targeting_after_opening.selection: uncaptured flag with minimum number of already assigned living squads

air.opening_patrol_heli: always requested at battle start and nonblocking

unmatched_passenger_squads: do not automatically adopt into combat structure

visualization.ambiguous_map_names: viewer must ask/select actual map instead of silently choosing false geometry

not_confirmed_implemented: infantry deployment about 100m before target and 5-6m front spacing
physical coordinate waypoint execution without a verified engine coordinate bridge
memory_rule: Any future user-requested bot behavior change must be written into THIS file first/at the same time as code, then tested and confirmed from LOG/.
